entries.note: Engelberts 2020 (PMID 31981978, epub 2020-01-23) abstract has the quote verbatim. FDA BLA 761324 review confirms monkey B-cell depletion. Opening untested at FIH 2018 proxy is fine.

entries.note: Retro right (Maloney 1994 predates model); epcoritamab sc, other_disease right. Lugtenburg ASH 2019 abstract (doi 10.1182/blood-2019-121460, 2019-11-13) states cyno B-cell depletion and 'rapid, complete depletion of circulating B cells' in patients: year 2019, comparison_stated true.
entries.adjudication_note: Status agreed: retro (retrodiction, rituximab depletion 1994 predates model). Rule 6 moves year to 2019: Lugtenburg ASH 2019 (DOI resolves) first stated monkey and patient B-cell depletion; comparison_stated true.

entries.rule: engagement: did the PD readout move in dosed humans (any dosed humans count); untested_reason not_measured requires no trial measured the readout
entries.note: Sawas 2017 full text (PMC5412890) does measure depletion: 'A rapid depletion in circulating lymphocytes was observed in all CLL patients, with most patients achieving a >50% reduction within 7 days'. Add a 2017 same entry (readout_tier downstream/proximal, paired).
entries.adjudication_note: Engagement rule: any dosed humans count. Sawas 2017 full text shows rapid circulating-lymphocyte depletion in all CLL patients on ublituximab, matching ex-vivo ADCC in direction. 2008 opener stays untested; track's latest becomes a 2017 paired same (rule 1).

entries.note: Quote is from the Lancet full text, which I could not open; FDA 761324 review (p.297) confirms RP2D came from a PBPK/PD model fitted to preclinical plus phase 1 data, with no monkey-stated exposure target or margin. untested/unpublished stands.
Engelberts abstract quote verbatim; FDA review confirms CDX/PDX (DLBCL) in humanized mice. No epcoritamab MZL efficacy readout found (MZL phase 2 NCT06796998 recruiting); untested/unsettled stands.
de Romeuf 2008 (PMID 18302712) abstract quote verbatim. Opening untested 2008 entry is correct.

entries.note: Retro right (Conconi 2003 predates 2008 model); ublituximab iv, stage_or_line right. Deng ASCO 2013 (doi 10.1200/jco.2013.31.15_suppl.8575, 2013-05-20), same trial: '1 CR (rituximab refractory MZL); 2 PR's (1 MZL, 1 FL)'. Year 2013; registry_date 2012-07-24 missing.
entries.adjudication_note: Status agreed: retro (Conconi 2003 predates 2008 ex-vivo model). Rule 6 moves year to 2013: Deng ASCO 2013 abstract (DOI resolves) first reported MZL responses on ublituximab; add registry_date 2012-07-24.

entries.note: Engelberts abstract quote verbatim; FDA review adds first-dose cytokine-associated signs and one death at 1 mg/kg IV, lower cytokines on SC.

Blood 2019;134(S1):758 quote verbatim; abstract states SC cyno lower cytokines beside non-severe patient CRS: comparison_stated true, year 2019, not retro, same. epcoritamab sc, other_disease (14/18 DLBCL) right. srcLabel should be Lugtenburg 2019 (first author).
Hart 2019 ASH abstract (fc.py scrape) has the quote verbatim ('300 mg per kg' as printed, likely a typo for ug/kg). No human depletion data in 2019; untested 2019, class level, fine.

GlobeNewswire 2025-01-09 quote verbatim; tier 5, trial_unreported true. Retro right (rituximab 1994 predates 2019 model); partial for shallower depletion. imvotamab iv, other_disease right. imported_from null though RA/SLE imported; set RA MONDO id.
Quote verbatim in Hart 2019; monkeys showed only transient IL-6 <200 pg/mL. A stated low-CRS prediction before patient data; untested 2019.
EHA 2022 P1276 (PMC9429641) quote verbatim: low CRS, no ICANS up to 1000 mg. Monkeys can show CRS and predicted it low in 2019, before patient data: prospective same, imported from mixed NHL.

Same PMC9429641 abstract states lower responses at 600/1000 mg were already observed before the synapse model was fitted; the model reproduces the 100 mg window. retro 2022, retrodiction true, correct.
Li 2022 CPT abstract quote verbatim; model guided 48 mg RP2D. Year 2020 is a proxy for RP2D selection (first public epub 2022); acceptable. Model was fitted partly to escalation patient data.

Sinnollareddy 2026 abstract quote verbatim; 48 mg regimen reached and response plateau held in FL expansion patients the model had not seen. Some escalation patients overlap the fitting data; see rule question. same 2026, within_2x.

entries.note: Sawas 2017 quote verbatim; retro, ublituximab iv, CLL other_disease right. But Cartron ASH 2010 (doi 10.1182/blood.V116.21.2447.2447, 2010-11-19) reported 'rapid, profound and sustained lymphocyte depletion' in 21 CLL pts on LFB-R603 (ublituximab): year 2010.
entries.adjudication_note: Status agreed: retro (rituximab depletion predates 2008 model). Rule 6 moves year to 2010: Cartron ASH 2010 (DOI resolves) first reported lymphocyte depletion in CLL patients on LFB-R603 (ublituximab).

missing: Imvotamab (member) engagement track: preclinical models claimed deep B-cell depletion, incl. low-CD20 cells (ACR abstract, acrabstracts.org 'Imvotamab ... effectively depletes low-expressing CD20 B cells in preclinical models'); phase 1b RA/SLE patients showed inadequate B-cell depletion and the drug was discontinued (IGM Biosciences press release 2025-01-09, globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/01/09/3007285; tier 5, trial_unreported). Candidate engagement contra, 2025, imported from RA/SLE.

Imvotamab NHL phase 1 NCT04082936 enrolled MZL (conditions list), terminated for pipeline prioritization, no posted results; EHA 2022 P1276 (PMC9429641) reports 60% ORR at 100 mg in R/R NHL. Draft note 'no MZL data found' should cite this trial.
Ublituximab B-cell depletion in MS patients (ULTIMATE I/II, Steinman 2022 NEJM; phase 2 Fox 2021) is a further human engagement readout for the ublituximab track.
rule_questions: Can an efficacy entry score a disease subset (8/35 MZL, 3 with tabulated responses) of a mixed trial when the subset is below the 80% bar and the quote speaks of indolent NHL as a whole?
Engagement for a member drug measured only in another disease (imvotamab in RA/SLE, ublituximab in MS): admissible as 'any dosed humans', and should it carry imported_from?
Is monkey silence on ICANS a safety miss, given monkeys showed 'uncoordinated movements' with cytokine release but neurotoxicity is debated as species-observable?

Models: epcoritamab PBPK/PD (Li 2022) was fitted to escalation-cohort patient PK/response data; the later FL exposure-response pools escalation and expansion patients. Is a comparison partly on the fitting data prospective (same) or retro? Scored same here because the expansion cohort was unseen.
Models: engagement contra vs same/partial when patients' depletion moved but fell short of the sponsor's depth bar (imvotamab RA/SLE, press release only).
